+File uploads
+------------
+
+The default value of the :setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` setting changed
+from ``None`` to ``0o644``.
+
+Historically, the default behavior with ``None`` resulted in permissions of
+uploaded files being either ``0o600`` or the system's standard umask value,
+depending on which upload handler was used, and thus on the size of the file
+being uploaded. This was inconsistent behavior, and the more sensible default
+of always setting a mode of ``0o644`` was chosen to remove this
+inconsistency.
+
+If you're relying on the previous default behavior, you may want to set
+:setting:`FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS` to ``None`` in your settings file.
+
